html:
The first scratch always hurts the most. It doesn’t matter how careful you are, your car’s paintwork is constantly exposed to damaging elements. That’s where Paint Protection Film (PPF) provides a strong layer of defence.

Designed to keep your car looking newer for longer, PPF is a professionally applied, self-healing wrap that shields painted surfaces from everyday wear and tear. With its hydrophobic surface, high-gloss clarity, and invisible finish, it offers long-term protection without altering your car’s appearance.

With more than 50 years of experience in vehicle surface protection, Tint a Car delivers expert solutions backed by a 10-year nationwide warranty*.

*Warranty terms, conditions and exclusions apply, ask in store for details. Warranty is non-transferable.

Why your car’s paint is more vulnerable than you think

Even the most cautious drivers can’t escape daily exposure to elements that damage paint. Whether you’re on the highway or parked under a tree, your car is at risk. Some of the most common threats include:

  • UV rays that fade and discolour paint
  • Swirl marks from washing and drying
  • Stone chips and road debris that leave permanent marks
  • Bug splatter, bird droppings, and tree sap that etch the surface
  • Salt and sand, particularly in coastal or rural environments

Even cleaning can cause damage if done incorrectly. And repairing paint damage isn’t cheap, with respraying just one panel costing anywhere from $300 to $1,000+. Preventing this damage with quality protection is a far more economical and effective approach.

What makes Paint Protection Film so effective

Paint Protection Film is a clear, durable film applied to your vehicle’s painted surfaces. Designed to be undetectable, it forms a high-gloss barrier that defends against damage while preserving your car’s original finish.

What sets it apart?

  • Self-healing surface: Light scratches and swirl marks fade away with exposure to heat or sunlight
  • Hydrophobic finish: Water, dirt, and contaminants slide off easily, reducing the risk of abrasion during cleaning
  • High-gloss clarity: Maintains a just-detailed appearance without changing the colour or tone of your paint
  • Invisible application: Professionally installed for a seamless look
  • Flexible coverage options: Apply to high-impact zones or the entire vehicle

This isn’t a do-it-yourself solution. Each wrap is applied by trained technicians to ensure precision, durability, and optimal performance. With Tint a Car, you’re choosing a premium solution that looks great and lasts.

How it compares to other paint protection options

When it comes to protecting your vehicle’s finish, not all options are equal. Waxes and sealants offer a temporary gloss but wear away quickly and provide minimal resistance to physical damage.

Paint Protection Film, by contrast, delivers a physical barrier that absorbs impact from debris while offering the same hydrophobic and self-healing properties. For drivers who want the best of both, PPF can also be applied under ceramic coatings to combine their benefits.

Over time, the cost of regular detailing, waxing, or paint correction adds up. This wrap is a one-time investment that protects against ongoing damage, making it a clear value choice for long-term car care.
